title: The Spider Venom Peptide Lycosin-II Has Potent Antimicrobial Activity against Clinically Isolated Bacteria.
adjudication_summary: Worker-2 recovered source-located MIC/toxicity rows from Table 1 and figures; worker-4 reconciled linked database rows while preserving APD6/dbAMP conflicts; worker-6 closes the original rework ticket with cautions rather than clean acceptance.

materials_exhausted.note: No supplementary assets or supplementary tables are present in the packet/OA package; XML/PDF/database rows supply the recoverable values.

per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Packet remains the material source surface; XML/PDF/OA/database inventory was reopened and no supplementary asset was available locally.
per_layer_decision_rationale.validator_contract: Required final and packet artifacts are structurally present; this is kept separate from source-reviewed acceptance.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP assay/literature rows are source-verified against Table 1/Figures 3-4 and article metadata; APD6/dbAMP mixed or conflicting summaries remain source_conflict cautions.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Table 1 MIC rows, Mg-conditioned MIC rows, and hemolysis row have concrete endpoints, values, units, targets, assay conditions, and locators.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism is kept as inferred membrane/salt-competition context and phenotypic time-kill support; no direct pore model is promoted.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: Original open ticket is closed only after strict semantic and publication gates pass; remaining issues are explicit nonblocking cautions.

caution_findings.evidence_context: APD6 narrative says 20% hemolysis at 100 µM/HC50>100 µM, but local primary text supports approximately 20% at 50 µM and no HC50.
dbAMP row includes additional ATCC/KCTC and repeated targets not supported by this paper packet; source-supported Table 1/Figure 3 values are kept separately.
Time-kill and hemolysis figures are available, but exact datapoints beyond text/caption statements are not tabulated locally.
Mg2+ competition and amphipathic cationic structure support membrane-binding inference, not a direct pore-model assignment.
